preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 200,000.
The number of edges m must be at least n - 1 and at most 200,000.
The number of clones k must be between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= n and 1 <= yi <= n for xi, yi in edges)
preconditions.description: All edge indices must be valid vertex indices between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly k lines, one for each clone.
Each clone's route must visit at most 6 vertices.
Each clone's route must contain at least one vertex.

postconditions.expression: all(any(v in route for route in output) for v in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: Every vertex from 1 to n must be visited by at least one clone.
